items.rationale: The leaking joint qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2. Necessary dismantling and refitting for access or drying is covered under §§5.2.6–5.2.7 at €90 for one service.
Section 5.2.7 covers necessary technical drying, subject to moisture documentation. The seven invoiced days total about €313 at the reference rate.
Section 7.4.4 excludes the unexplained surcharge without an itemised materials list. If properly substantiated, one surcharge would be about €39.
Necessary replacement of insulation disturbed during access is covered under §5.2.6, and mineral wool in the original diameter meets §7.14(c). One unit is estimated at €26.
Section 5.2.2 pays only the first charge for the same disposal. This is the first-listed charge, and the comparable single disposal allowance is €60.
Section 5.2.6 covers levelling the affected wall substrate as part of making good. One unit is estimated at €38.
Section 5.2.6 covers necessary substrate preparation, but §§3.5(d) and 7.4.1 bar work already reflected in the levelling or labour lines. If this is distinct work, 2.78 m² at €35/m² totals €97.30.
Section 5.2.6 expressly covers a necessary service opening to reach the damaged area. The comparable single opening in Case 46 supports €18.50.
The tiles meet the format limit in §7.14(d), subject to the comparable-grade requirement in §7.1.6. Five tiles at an estimated €55 each total €275.
The designer tiles exceed the 90 × 90 cm limit, and §3.5(f) bars partial payment on an over-threshold line. If accepted on a standard-equivalent basis, five units at €55 would total €275.
Sections 5.2.6 and 7.14(a) allow standard sanitary silicone joints on the reinstated wall. The invoiced 3.6 m at about €13/m totals €47.
Section 7.4.2 allows one travel charge per contractor per document. The single tiling travel charge is estimated at €83 using Case 46.
Section 7.4.1 covers necessary skilled labour not already included in another line. The 14 invoiced hours at the €90 full-cover rate total €1,260.

items.description: Remove basement drywall and insulation wool
items.rationale: Section 5.2.6 covers necessary removal in the affected basement, though the combined flat rate may need a breakdown under §7.4.4. Comparable drywall and insulation removal components are about €50 and €46, respectively.
Section 5.2.6 covers removal of damp plaster within the basement damage area. The single invoiced unit is estimated at €29 using the reference unit rate.
Section 3.5(b) excludes the unrelated attic work because no loss damage was established there. If covered, the one invoiced removal unit would be about €29.
Sections 3.5(d) and 5.2.2 exclude this second charge for the same disposal. If it were the payable first charge, one flat rate would be €60.
